title: Sort feedback with explicit heuristics
description: You can trace how keyword order assigns example feedback to action buckets.

steps.description: FEEDBACK stores reviewer, category, and text. The example includes strengths, questions, and risks.
triage_item checks crash-related words first, scope-related words second, and otherwise chooses DISCLOSE. Its docstring labels this a heuristic.

steps.question: Which bucket wins when a card contains both nested and crash?
steps.answer: FIX wins because the crash-word test runs first and returns immediately.

steps.description: The loop separates strengths before classifying other cards. It preserves each card's reviewer and text in its bucket.
The supplied report lists four FIX items, three DISCLOSE items, and one FUTURE item. Owner and disclosure blanks are printed placeholders rather than assignments or file writes.
